decisions.statement: A read asked for after the sweep's whole deadline has passed is refused unasked.
A slow cluster ends the sweep rather than the sweep running on.
A resource names its manager or states nothing.
A resource stating nothing is read as managed by nothing.
A cluster answering anything but success ends the sweep rather than reading as an empty namespace.
The credentials are read here rather than at cluster-api-reaching.
Cluster-api-reaching has the same three environment variables.

definition: the deployments, services and stateful sets a namespace is running
